transcript.line: Bahut achha beta, shukriya.

transcript.speaker: Operator
transcript.line: Namaste aunty ji, main Riya bol rahi hoon. Bataiye.

transcript.line: Beta, geyser chal nahi raha. Pani garam hi nahi ho raha, aur thande pani se main nahi nahati.

transcript.line: Switch on karne par light jalti hai? Koi awaaz ya jalne ki smell aati hai?

transcript.line: Light toh jalti hai, par pani thanda hi rehta hai. Koi smell nahi hai.

transcript.line: Namaste uncle ji, main Riya bol rahi hoon. Kya madad chahiye?

transcript.line: Beta, mere phone par video call nahi lag rahi. Bete ka call aata hai, awaaz aati hai par screen kaali dikhti hai.

transcript.speaker: Operator
transcript.line: Achha, aapne camera ke liye koi setting badli thi kya?

transcript.speaker: Parent
transcript.line: Pata nahi beta. Pichle hafte phone gir gaya tha, tab se yeh dikkat hai.

transcript.speaker: Operator
transcript.line: Koi baat nahi, ek helper aayega jo phone theek se samjhata hai. Kab convenient rahega?

transcript.speaker: Parent
transcript.line: Kal dopahar teen baje ke baad, jab main aaram kar leta hoon.

transcript.speaker: Operator
